divergences.line: skill2 Overheat II/III duration — reviewer reads 'continuously' + no removal clause as PERMANENT once earned (survives Prediction end)

The prose explicitly GATES both tiers: 'While in Prediction and Overheat I status, Overheat II ...' / 'While in Prediction and Overheat II status, Overheat III ...'. The 30/60-hit ramp-in is approximated as full-window uptime (documented slight early-window overcount). Test G5 pins the 10s window (first fires on the first burst frame, once per burst, expiresFrame-frame == 600).
divergences.outcome: no change; shipped 'While in Prediction' 10s gate is the faithful reading, reviewer permanent-reading over-credits
